payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the Zero-Shot Adaptive Transfer method in slot tagging, indicating significant performance enhancements over existing models.

claims.text: The model shows an improvement of 7.24% in absolute F1-score with 2000 training instances.
The model achieves an improvement of 14.57% in absolute F1-score with only 500 training instances.
ZAT shows a mean improvement of 4.04, 5.37, and 3.27 points over LSTM-BoE for training sizes of 500, 1000, and 2000, respectively.
ZAT has an average improvement of 2.58, 2.44, and 2.5 points over CT for training sizes of 500, 1000, and 2000, respectively.
